name: Hot Tubs
description:
Hot tubs

Four wooden hot tubs from €2,548 to €7,811: round tubs with an external or an integrated firewood stove, an oval double tub for two, and a square tub for seven. Water capacity from 650 to 1,500 litres. Delivered to the UK, Ireland and Europe.

Choosing a hot tub

Square hot tub72.2 x 2.2 m1,500 l€7,811

Heating. An external stove sits outside the tub and keeps the bathing space free. An integral stove sits inside the water. The round integral tub is also offered with an electric heater.

Timber. The integral tub is listed in larch, red cedar, thermowood or wood composite.

Placement. A firm, level base, water nearby and space around the stove.

Make it a wellness corner with an outdoor sauna.
